action: Trace PeerRequestOptions.meta application relative to the seeded SEP-2575 client context on the pinned ordinary tools/call request path.
result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RoleClient::configure_direct_peer seeds ClientRequestMetadata only for protocol versions >= 2026-07-28. Peer::send_request always delegates to send_request_with_option using PeerRequestOptions::no_options, and Peer::call_tool_once delegates to send_request; therefore the concrete ordinary call_tool_once path supplies no explicit per-request meta and does not override the seeded protocolVersion/clientCapabilities values. In the option-bearing path, send_request_with_option_and_subscription first writes seeded protocolVersion, clientInfo and clientCapabilities into RequestMetaObject, then applies options.meta with request.get_meta_mut().extend(meta), and only afterward sets progressToken. RequestMetaObject::extend delegates to MetaObject::extend, whose source contract inserts every incoming entry and overwrites existing keys on conflict. Therefore an explicit PeerRequestOptions.meta supplied through an option-bearing request API can replace the JSON values of either 2026-07-28 required key io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion or io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities after the defaults are seeded. This overwrite path is source-proven at the pinned commit; it is not exercised by ordinary call_tool_once/send_request because that path uses no_options. No claim is made about server-side rejection/validation of an overridden value, deployed servers, authentication, ChatGPT connector exposure, network captures, or end-to-end parity.
